name: specify
summary: Start a feature: Claude and Codex research the codebase independently, then a spec draft is written in Spec Kit's format.

name: clarify
summary: Claude and Codex each question the spec draft; you answer the merged questions and the spec is revised with your answers.

name: plan
summary: Claude and Codex write independent plans, rebut each other's, the plans are merged (real disagreements come to you), then both attack the merged plan.

name: tasks
summary: Break the plan into a Spec Kit tasks.md; tasks marked [P] are independent and will be implemented concurrently.
produces: tasks.md, committed together with the spec and plan
ask: break the current feature into tasks

name: analyze
summary: Claude and Codex each audit spec, plan and tasks for gaps, ambiguity, coverage and constitution conflicts before any code is written.
ask: check the current feature's spec, plan and tasks for consistency

name: implement
summary: Implement every task: one model implements, the project's checks run, the other model reviews, until approved; tasks alternate between Claude and Codex.
produces: one reviewed commit per task, ticked in tasks.md

name: converge
summary: Audit the whole feature against its spec; unmet criteria become fix tasks (with your go-ahead), then a report is written.
ask: audit and finish the current feature
